mapping.title: Column Mapping Wizard · Fix key===header fragility
mapping.ruleHint: Auto-match rule: exact equality or contains match (e.g. `Name` matches `Real Name`, `Email` matches `Email Address`). Verify each Excel header maps to correct config key; leave unmapped to create new in next step.
mapping.tip: Tip: if headers differ only by case or substring, they are auto-filled; manually set to "No mapping" to create new.
mapping.newFieldHint: Unmatched headers can be checked as "New Field" and edit display label (defaults to header). Matched headers can also be checked to override mapping.
mapping.allMatched: All headers matched, no new fields needed. Proceed to preview.
mapping.confirmHint: Review mapping changes; cancellable before confirm, rollback via "Config Builder" after confirm.
mapping.applyHint: After apply: 1) {count} fields added to listFields/detailGroups 2) raw data remapped 3) config auto-saved. Cancel before apply has no effect; after confirm, remove fields in "Config Builder" or reload example to rollback.
